Method of Attack: Distribution via malicious email campaigns with attached Word documents containing malicious macros
Macros invoke PowerShell to download and install malware payload
Payload includes banking trojan capabilities, information stealers, email collectors, ransomware
Checks recipient IP against blacklists (Spamhaus, SpamCop, SORBS) to evade spam filters
Changes email subject lines to evade spam filters
Uses HTTP 301 redirects in download requests
Malware hosted on compromised websites used as random hosting locations
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (victims opening malicious Word documents)
Attack Vector: Direct links to malware in email body
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Word documents with embedded macros
Emails containing direct malware download links
Use of HTTP 301 redirects pointing to same URL with different headers
Spam lists blacklists (Spamhaus, SpamCop, SORBS) checks
